title: DOW-UAP-PR34, Unresolved UAP Report, Greece, October 2023
doc_notes: This is a declassified military mission report (MISREP) from USCENTCOM containing a documented UAP incident report.

encounters.summary: Military aircraft observed a circular UAP flying just above the ocean surface performing 90-degree turns at 80 mph before disappearing from the sensor feed.
encounters.entity_appearance: Seemingly circular, too small to make out details
encounters.entity_behavior: Performed sharp 90 degree turns at 80 mph
encounters.quote: The UAP took multiple 90 degree turns at an estimated 80 mph.
